title: Guided course discovery and contextual AI teaching
summary: Find a starting point or resume learning, and request a simple explanation, concrete example or guided practice with the current lesson attached.

changes.detail: Added Start from zero, Build a website and Understand AI goal filters, a resume card for unfinished curriculum lessons, and Help me choose routing to the teacher.
Course discovery initially shows published topics so learners can start immediately; all topics remain accessible.
Added Explain this lesson to course lesson lists and an expandable teacher-help panel in lesson readers with explain, example and practice actions.
Teacher requests opened from a general question default to the general topic instead of Next.js.
Centralized localized teacher intents and regression tests for context transfer, explicit help selection and guided discovery.

validation.name: Automated checks
validation.detail: Typecheck, lint, guidance/navigation, completion and history tests pending.

validation.name: Live AI and visual review
validation.detail: No paid/live AI request, native-device or visual review performed. No deployment.
